title: When AI gets it wrong: a six-step routine for checking what a chatbot tells you

posts.facebook:
A chatbot sounds just as sure when it is wrong as when it is right. Six quick checks tell you which is which.

Why a fluent answer from an AI assistant can still be wrong, what the makers and independent research say about it, and which answers need checking. A six-step routine and five warning signs for anything touching health, money, law or deadlines.

For anything about health, money, law or dates, open the source yourself and confirm one key fact before you act.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/ai/when-ai-gets-it-wrong-how-to-check/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
